cache_state: new runtime; consecutive requests; prompt cache off; OS page cache not purged
notes: Baseline and reversed use separate processes. Slots stay resident between requests within each process.
Reversed uses Python line tracing to sample MLX active/peak counters; it does not allocate MLX arrays or add GPU synchronization.
Do not use timings for speed comparisons: single runs, observer overhead, OS page cache unpurged, other desktop workloads not controlled.
UI labels GB but divides bytes by 1024^3, so these numbers are GiB.
Baseline harness did not record pre-request resident count; reversed records it.
